diff.prompt.b2_earlier_context: Earlier context separates exact source excerpts from fallible prior hypotheses. Use relevant earlier source excerpts when current text leaves a rule unstated; prefer an explicit current-source revision when the same rule changes. Never treat a prior hypothesis as a fact. Select short exact quotes carrying the source rules needed by your summary; only your verified quotes, not the full earlier context, are passed to the answer component. If required evidence is absent, state that uncertainty and request re-entry rather than inventing it. Quotes may cite only current source text or an exact earlier source excerpt, never own-state or hypotheses. Copy every quote character for character from one source sentence: same words, capitals and punctuation; never shorten, join or reword it. When the current text does not restate a project rule such as budget, deadline or a local-only requirement, quote the whole earlier source sentence that states it, word for word.
